text:
katie: Heads-up — I'm putting together a pilot playbook for the Acme deal. We need to lock POC success criteria, answer security questionnaire items, confirm pricing floor, and finalize the eval harness + golden prompts. Thread to capture owners and blockers.

matt: I'll own eval harness and golden dataset. Quick Q: do we want intent-level labels or full-response grading?

jia: I'll take security Qs (KMS, SOC2, VPC options). Send me the customer's questionnaire PDF and any non-negotiable asks.

samir: Pricing question — are they expecting dedicated capacity or hosted with burst? That changes discounting and min commitment.

olivia: Timeline suggestion: 1 week infra/setup, 2 weeks evaluation (3 weeks total). Can compress to 2 if we reuse existing datasets.

katie: Use cases to prioritize: customer support triage (routing + suggested replies), private KB retrieval + citation, and concise summarization for long transcripts. For prompts we need golden inputs for each: ~70 triage tickets, ~80 retrieval queries, ~50 long transcripts (summary).

matt: Proposed scoring rubric (simple CSV-ready cols):
- example_id
- use_case
- input
- expected_output
- human_score_0_5
- safety_flag_0_1
- latency_ms
- cost_tokens

matt: Regression / pass gates (proposal):
```
# thresholds
MIN_ACCURACY = 0.88  # weighted across use cases
MAX_SAFETY_VIOLATION_RATE = 0.005  # 0.5% of samples
MAX_AVG_LATENCY_MS = 600
COST_DELTA_THRESHOLD = 0.15  # >15% cost increase blocks rollout
```

olivia: Add: block rollout if accuracy drops >5% relative to baseline on golden set OR any safety violations on high-sensitivity samples. Also require per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95).

jia: Security checklist (high-level):
- KMS: customer-managed key option (Y/N)
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink for Private deploys
- Data: retention policy + delete-on-demand support
- Audit: request-level logging + SIEM integration
- Compliance: provide SOC2 attestation + penetration test summary
Please call out anything Acme marked "must-have."

samir: Pricing scenarios (rough):
Scenario A — Hosted, pay-as-you-go:
- No commit, higher per-token cost, low up-front. Estimated cost for pilot (3 weeks): $4k-$7k depending on traffic.
Scenario B — Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit):
- 4x GPU pool reserved, discounted rate ~30% off hosted. Monthly commit ~ $18k, pro-rated for pilot.
Add-ons: 24/7 support + extended retention billed separately.

katie: Actions and owners:
- matt: produce golden dataset sketch + scoring CSV template by Tue EOD (owner: matt, due: Tue)
- jia: draft answers to customer security QA + list of missing OkRs by Wed (owner: jia, due: Wed)
- samir: write pricing options + simple TCO scenarios by Wed (owner: samir, due: Wed)
- olivia: confirm timeline + orchestrate infra slots with eng on Thu (owner: olivia, due: Thu)
- katie: compile playbook and send to customer on Fri before alignment call (owner: katie, due: Fri)

eval-bot: Generated provisional golden-set link: https://redwood.internal/evals/acme/provisional (placeholder) :robot_face:

matt: One more: for the golden dataset we'll include 30* augmentation variants per input (paraphrases) to make regression detection robust.

samir: Pricing ask for sales deck — add a small example TCO table showing cost/token and monthly commit breakpoints. I'll draft a simple ascii table and push to the deck.

katie: Final — let's do a 30-min sync Friday 11:00am PT to confirm handoffs. Add agenda: quick run through use cases, scoring rubric, security open items, pricing scenarios, and next steps. Calendar invite incoming. :thumbsup:
